memory_candidates.content: When a research/ingest dispatch registers a new literature-index entry but never commits it, a follow-up implementation task must independently re-verify the registration (entry field completeness, index parity, on-disk chunk counts, FTS retrievability) rather than trusting the prior report's self-reported figures. Concretely useful check sequence: jq entry-field presence -> jq .entries|length on both sub-index and global index -> ls chunk_*.md | wc -l -> literature-search.sh smoke test.

To earn (not just assert) a verified_conversion fidelity label on a converted document, spot-check at least one theorem, one definition, and one section heading (with page numbers) against a freshly re-downloaded, checksum-compared source PDF using pdftotext/PyMuPDF text extraction -- a quality-gate pass alone (no rejection, no control-character repairs) is a weaker bar and should not by itself justify the label.
